SECTION: This is a synthetic example document. Pellingham Circuits is a fictional fabricator, and Kestle Coatings, Orrin Laminates and Fennick Foil, with every product named here (PS-40, PL-350, PL-410, PL-420, FF-2), are fictional too. The Dk, Df and roughness figures are illustrative and describe no real material.
Layer numbering is 1-based from the top (L1 = top copper, L6 = bottom copper). Dielectric and soldermask layers are not numbered.

Depth_mm for the laser microvias is the ablated dielectric alone, excluding the copper at either end. For the mechanical through hole it is the finished board thickness, copper included. Aspect ratio is depth over finished hole.
Every FAB_RULES limit is INCLUSIVE: a value equal to a limit meets it. The microvias sit on the 0.80:1 laser limit by construction.
SE-50 is a grounded coplanar line on L1. L2 is voided under the line, so the line's reference plane is L3; the coplanar gap is the Clearance_mm.
Differential pair gap is stated edge to edge. Clearance is stated edge to edge to the nearest adjacent copper, fence vias included.
Copper roughness is stated as Rz in micrometers, matte and drum side separately.
